sentences.text:
vs In Re : Ajoy Ghosh @ Buro on 8
April, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
April 08, 2025 61 Ardr (Non-prosecution) Crm(Db) 697 of 2025 In Re : An Application for bail
under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with
Narayanpur Police Station Case No. 117 dated 14/8/2023 under Sections 498A/302/201 of the
Indian Penal Code read with Section 25 and 27 of the Arms Act And In Re : Ajoy Ghosh @ Buro ...
Petitioner.
Adv. Ajay Debnath, Adv. Pranesha Naskar, ... for the petitioner.
Adv. Subhamoy Bhattacharya, Adv. Subhasish Datta, ...for the State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner does not intend to proceed with the application any further.
Accordingly, the application is dismissed for non-prosecution.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
